C0204.title: Hunan Guidong Police Crack Cross-Provincial Click Farm Traffic Fraud Case
C0204.summary: In September 2025, Guidong police in Hunan dismantled a cross-provincial click farm operation that provided paid fake reposts, likes, and comments to manipulate online engagement metrics, severing the fraudulent traffic chain.

references.title: Cutting Off the 'Traffic Manipulation' Chain! Guidong Police in Hunan Bust a Cross-Provincial 'Online Water Army' Case
